# HetAas Atelier

> Handmade resin art from Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India: bookmarks, earrings, keychains, coasters, pooja thalis, car hangings and custom name pieces. Every piece is made to order (curing 4-6 days). Payment is pre-paid through PayPal.

## Agent access

- Product catalogue (JSON): https://hetaas-atelier.aasthathakker.com/products.json
- Shop info and FAQs (JSON): https://hetaas-atelier.aasthathakker.com/content.json
- Agent endpoint (MCP-style JSON-RPC over HTTP POST): https://hetaas-api.automated-aesthetix.workers.dev/mcp
  - tools: search_products, get_product, create_checkout (returns a PayPal approveUrl for the buyer)

## Policies

- Pre-paid orders only, via PayPal.
- No returns, refunds or exchanges on customized items.
- Delivery cost is paid by the buyer. Self pickup in Ahmedabad is free.

## Contact

- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/hetaas_atelier
